candidate_reports.remark: In West Warwick_ a basement apartment flooded and basement apartments were evacuated. Relayed by amateur radio.
In Fall River_ major flooding was reported on Plymouth Ave. Relayed by amateur radio.
In New Bedford_ North Front Street was closed from Coggeshall St to the fish houses due to flooding. Relayed by amateur radio.
In Fall River_ the Route 24 SB on ramp to I-95 was closed due to 1 foot of street flooding. Relayed by amateur radio.
In West Greenwich Nooseneck Hill Rd was flooded and impassable. Relayed by amateur radio.
In New Bedford_ Belleville Ave was flooded and impassable. Relayed by amateur radio.
In Cranston_ Reservoir Ave was flooded.
In Fall River_ North Main St_ Davol St_ Oman St_ and Grinnell St had flooding. A car was stuck in flooding on Russell Brogan Blvd and New Boston Rd. Relayed by amateur radio.
In Providence_ Huntington Ave was flooded. Relayed by amateur radio.
In West Warwick_ several homes were reported to have flooded on Newell Street. Relayed by amateur radio.
In Warwick_ a car was stuck in street flooding and the road was impassible on Coastaway Blvd near Metro Center Blvd. Relayed via amateur radio.
